bio.text: Norman "Sayf" Ramsay is the Republican and Conservative candidate for New York's 60th Assembly District in Brooklyn, challenging Democratic incumbent Nikki Lucas, the Canarsie Courier reported.
The Courier reported that he says his community work is carried out through BK5860, Inc., Sayf Haven and the Alternatives to Violence Project.

sources.title: Norman Ramsay Brings Redemption, Community Service and an Affordability Agenda to AD 60 Race
